preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(n == int(n) and 1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: Each test case's length n is an integer between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for n, s in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], stdin.splitlines()[2::2]))
preconditions.description: Each string s has length exactly equal to its corresponding n.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() for c in s) for s in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
preconditions.description: Each string s consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line == str(min_erased) or output_line == '-1' for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either the minimum number of erased symbols (as a string) or '-1' if it's impossible.

postconditions.expression: all(min_erased == min(sum(1 for i in range(n) if s[i] == c) - count for c in set(s) for count in [count_matching_pairs(s, c)]) if possible else -1 for s, n in zip(stdin.splitlines()[2::2], [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]))
postconditions.description: For each string s, the output is the minimum number of symbols to erase to make it a palindrome by choosing one letter c and erasing some of its occurrences, or -1 if no such c exists.

postconditions.expression: all(min_erased == 0 if s == s[::-1] else min_erased for s in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
postconditions.description: If the string is already a palindrome, the output is 0.
